scholarships.name: UNSW Scholarships for International Students Commencing Term 1, 2027
scholarships.amount: From $5,000 up to full tuition (varies by award)
scholarships.eligibility: International students with an offer of admission for Term 1 2027 by 30 October 2026; selected on merit, leadership and other criteria.
scholarships.notes: Closes 11:59pm AEST. Page lists two different open dates (6 and 15 July 2026).

scholarships.name: Research Stipend Scholarships (RTP / RMIT) – 2027 round
scholarships.amount: $36,245 per year stipend (2026 rate, indexed; 2027 rate not yet published) plus tuition fee offset
scholarships.eligibility: Domestic full applications close 30 October 2026 (international deadline has passed). Competitive, ranked on academic achievement and research outputs.
scholarships.notes: Close date from https://www.rmit.edu.au/research/research-degrees/how-to-apply

scholarships.name: Research Training Program (RTP) Stipend – Round 4 (domestic)
scholarships.amount: $37,145 per year (2026 rate); domestic students automatically receive an RTP Fees Offset
scholarships.eligibility: Domestic students (Australian/NZ citizens, permanent residents, humanitarian visa holders).
scholarships.notes: Page states 'Round 4 (Domestic) closes 31 October' without a year. Next international round (Round 1) closes 31 March.

scholarships.name: 2027 Domestic HDR Scholarship Round (RTP Stipend)
scholarships.amount: $39,253 per year (2027 value); domestic tuition covered automatically
scholarships.eligibility: Domestic students, plus UWA international graduates who completed (or will complete) their qualifying UWA degree in 2025–2026.
scholarships.notes: Closes 11:59pm AWST. 2027 international round closed 15 Sep 2026.

scholarships.name: Graduate Research Talent Scheme (AURS / RTPS) – Round 1, 2027
scholarships.amount: Living stipend plus 100% tuition fee waiver for the duration of the award
scholarships.eligibility: Domestic applicants, or international applicants who have completed (or are completing in 2026) a relevant Australian or NZ qualification.
scholarships.notes: Closes 5pm ACDT. Stipend amount is in the Conditions of Award PDF, not on the page.

scholarships.name: UTS Vice-Chancellor's International Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.amount: UTS tuition fees
scholarships.eligibility: International students who completed Year 12 within the last 3 years with an 85% overall average; must apply via the UTS scholarships form.
scholarships.notes: Closes 11:55pm AEST. For Autumn 2027 (February) commencement.

scholarships.name: Curtin STAR Scholarship (Future Students) – Semester 1, 2027
scholarships.amount: $500 to $1,500 per semester
scholarships.eligibility: Domestic students commencing an undergraduate degree at Curtin in Semester 1, 2027.

scholarships.name: Vice Chancellor's International Scholarship
scholarships.amount: 50% of tuition fees for the whole degree (subject to ongoing eligibility)
scholarships.eligibility: New international students with a minimum prior GPA of 6.0/7 (or equivalent) and an offer by the closing date, starting full-time in 2026 or 2027.
scholarships.notes: Trimester 1 2027 deadline. Australian Year 12 completers: apply by 21 December 2026.

scholarships.name: RTP / University of Sydney International Stipend and Tuition Fee Scholarships
scholarships.amount: $44,293 per year stipend (2027 rate) plus 100% tuition fees; RTP Fee Offset includes OSHC
scholarships.eligibility: International students commencing or enrolled in a higher degree by research; competitive. Must also apply for admission.
scholarships.notes: Deadline for Research Periods 3 and 4, 2027. Fully funded (tuition + stipend).

scholarships.name: Vice-Chancellor's International High Achievers Scholarship (VCIHAS)
scholarships.amount: 50% of tuition fees for the full duration of the course
scholarships.eligibility: International fee-paying students with at least 95% overall in their highest completed qualification; supporting statement (up to 600 words) required.
scholarships.notes: Semester 1 2027 deadline; Semester 2 2027 closes 4 Jul 2027.

scholarships.name: HDR Scholarships for International Candidates (incl. International RTP) – July 2027 round
scholarships.amount: $37,500 per year stipend (2027) plus tuition fees; iRTP also includes single OSHC
scholarships.eligibility: International candidates meeting ELR Band 2 English requirements and HDR admission requirements; competitive.
scholarships.notes: For July 2027 commencement. Fully funded (tuition + stipend) for iRTP.

scholarships.name: Curtin Global Talent Scholarship
scholarships.amount: One-off $10,000 credit against tuition fees
scholarships.eligibility: International, full fee-paying, non-sponsored students of any nationality commencing at a Curtin WA campus in 2027.

scholarships.name: 2027 Africa International Scholarship
scholarships.amount: 20% tuition fee reduction for the standard course duration
scholarships.level: Undergraduate and Master by Coursework (eligible courses)
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of eligible African countries (see official list) commencing on campus at Joondalup, City or South West in 2027; full fee-paying, non-sponsored.

scholarships.name: 2027 ECU Success Scholarship
scholarships.amount: 15% to 25% tuition fee reduction (rises as you progress)
scholarships.level: Undergraduate and Master by Coursework (eligible courses)
scholarships.field: Eligible courses listed on the official page
scholarships.eligibility: International students commencing an eligible ECU course in 2027.

scholarships.name: University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship (UoADS)
scholarships.amount: NZ$35,468 per year tax-free stipend (2026 rate) plus tuition fees for up to 42 months
scholarships.eligibility: Anyone offered a place in a University of Auckland doctoral programme is considered (international doctoral students who pay domestic fees included); must not already hold a doctorate.
scholarships.notes: Fully funded (tuition + stipend). Next rounds: 1 Feb, 1 May and 1 Aug 2027. No separate application; confirm interest on the doctoral application. Some professional doctorates excluded for international students.

scholarships.university: Te Herenga Waka – Victoria University of Wellington
scholarships.name: Wellington Doctoral Scholarship
scholarships.amount: NZ$32,000 stipend per year plus domestic tuition fees (up to three years)
scholarships.eligibility: Graduates of any university, in NZ or overseas, enrolling full-time in a first PhD at Victoria University of Wellington.
scholarships.notes: Rounds close 1 March, 1 July and 1 November each year; next round is 1 March 2027. Page lists eligibility as International and Domestic but covers domestic tuition fees only, so not labelled fully funded.

scholarships.name: UC Doctoral Scholarship (May 2027 round)
scholarships.amount: NZ$32,650 per 120 points plus thesis tuition, up to 360 points
scholarships.eligibility: Applicants admitted to a UC research doctorate with first-class honours or master's equivalent, starting in the second half of 2027.
scholarships.notes: Must also apply for doctoral admission. The page doesn't mention international students explicitly; confirm with UC before applying.

scholarships.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
scholarships.amount: Full university fee plus £23,152 maintenance for 12 months (2026-27 rate), airfares, visa costs and health surcharge
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the UK applying for a full-time PhD, MLitt or one-year postgraduate course at Cambridge.
scholarships.notes: Fully funded. Deadline is 8 Dec 2026 or 6 Jan 2027 depending on your course (check the Cambridge Course Directory); 11:59pm UK time. US round has closed.

scholarships.name: President's PhD Scholarships
scholarships.amount: Full tuition plus £27,036 per year stipend (2027-28 rate) and £2,000 per year consumables (first 3 years)
scholarships.eligibility: No nationality restrictions (some departments may not support international candidates); contact an Imperial supervisor and apply through admissions.
scholarships.notes: Fully funded. Three rounds: 2 Nov 2026, 11 Jan 2027 and 1 Mar 2027 (23:59 UK time). Applying early is advised.

scholarships.name: Leiden University Excellence Scholarship (LExS)
scholarships.amount: Tuition fee reduction of €10,000 to €19,000
scholarships.field: Most fields (some Law LLM and MSc programmes excluded)
scholarships.eligibility: Non-EEA/non-EFTA passport holders applying to a Leiden Master's programme starting in September.
scholarships.notes: Admission application and LExS motivation letter must both be in by the deadline. February starts excluded.

scholarships.university: Campus France (French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs)
scholarships.name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
scholarships.amount: €1,200 per month (Master's) or €2,000 per month (PhD), plus airfare, health insurance and housing help; tuition waived for national diplomas/accredited engineering degrees at public institutions
scholarships.field: Science, engineering, health, law, politics, economics and management (see official list)
scholarships.eligibility: International students up to 29 (Master's) or 35 (PhD), nominated by a French university. Students can't apply directly.
scholarships.notes: 6 Jan 2027 is the deadline for French universities to submit nominations; the university's own internal deadline will be earlier, so contact them now.

scholarships.name: Edinburgh Global Undergraduate Mathematics Scholarships
scholarships.amount: £5,000 each
scholarships.eligibility: Applicants with International/EU fee status accepted for full-time undergraduate study in the School of Mathematics.
scholarships.notes: Deadline 23:59 UK time.

scholarships.university: Princeton University (School of Public and International Affairs)
scholarships.name: Princeton SPIA MPA Funding
scholarships.amount: 100% of tuition and required fees for all MPA students, plus a need-based living stipend for two years
scholarships.eligibility: Domestic and international applicants to the two-year Master in Public Affairs (GRE required).
scholarships.notes: Funding comes with admission; no separate scholarship form. Deadline 11:59pm ET.

scholarships.name: Cornelius Vanderbilt Scholarship
scholarships.amount: Full tuition plus a one-time summer stipend
scholarships.eligibility: First-year applicants, international applicants included, who submit the separate merit scholarship application.
scholarships.notes: Separate merit application in MyAppVU, as well as the admission application. Housing and food not included.

scholarships.name: Ingram Scholars Program
scholarships.amount: Full tuition, required fees and on-campus housing each year, plus a summer service stipend
scholarships.eligibility: First-year applicants, international included, with a strong commitment to community service.
scholarships.notes: Apply through your MyAppVU account.

scholarships.name: Fulbright Canada Traditional Student Awards
scholarships.amount: US$25,000 for one academic year (8 months)
scholarships.eligibility: Canadian citizens only, who want to study or do research in the United States in 2027-28.
scholarships.notes: For Canadians going to the US. Awards start September 2027.

scholarships.name: President's International Scholarship of Excellence
scholarships.amount: C$180,000 over four years (C$45,000 per year)
scholarships.eligibility: International high-school students entering first year at York in Fall 2027 with at least an 80% average, nominated by their school.
scholarships.notes: Application due 11:59pm EST; school nomination and reference due 4 Feb 2027. Max two nominees per school.

scholarships.name: Undergraduate Scholars Entrance Scholarship (USES)
scholarships.amount: C$140,000 for international students (8 × C$17,500)
scholarships.eligibility: High-school applicants for Fall 2027 with at least a 90% average (or 31 IB points) and strong extracurriculars.
scholarships.notes: Deadline 11:59pm Pacific. References and full admission file due 31 Jan 2027. SFU noted the online application was briefly offline for maintenance until 2 Nov 2026.

scholarships.name: Ontario Graduate Scholarship (OGS)
scholarships.amount: C$15,000 per year
scholarships.eligibility: Full-time students in, or applying to, a research graduate program at Western; international students need a valid study permit.
scholarships.notes: Closes 4:00pm ET. Check your program offers OGS.

scholarships.name: International Scholars Program (incl. Karen McKellin International Leader of Tomorrow Award)
scholarships.amount: Need-based, value varies; awards range up to the full cost of the academic program and living expenses
scholarships.eligibility: International students coming straight from secondary school with top grades, leadership and significant financial need.
scholarships.notes: Deadline 15 November 2026, 11:59pm Pacific (year confirmed on UBC's dates and deadlines page). Must also apply to UBC by the same date. Nominator and teacher forms are due a few days earlier. Not every award is full cost.

scholarships.name: 2027 Americas International Scholarship
scholarships.amount: 20% tuition fee reduction for the standard duration of the course
scholarships.level: Undergraduate and Master by Coursework (eligible courses)
scholarships.field: Most ECU Bachelor courses (excl. one-year Honours and WAAPA) and listed Master by Coursework courses
scholarships.eligibility: Full fee-paying, non-sponsored citizens of the USA, Canada, Mexico, Chile or Peru starting an eligible ECU course on campus (Joondalup, City or South West) in 2027.
scholarships.notes: Assessed automatically when you apply for the course; no separate application. Tuition only; cannot be deferred.

scholarships.name: 2027 Bachelor of Science (Nursing) (C33) First-Year International Scholarship
scholarships.amount: 20% reduction of first-year tuition fees
scholarships.eligibility: International students entering first year of the Bachelor of Science (Nursing) C33 onshore at Joondalup or South West (Bunbury) in Semester 1 or 2, 2027, without credit for prior learning.
scholarships.notes: Assessed automatically; no separate application. Covers the first year only, tuition only.

scholarships.name: 2027 Creative Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.amount: 10% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the course
scholarships.level: Undergraduate and Master by Coursework (eligible courses)
scholarships.field: Creative arts (listed courses, incl. Master of Creative Arts Entrepreneurship and Cultural Innovation)
scholarships.eligibility: International students starting an eligible creative course onshore at ECU City Campus in Semester 1 or 2, 2027.
scholarships.notes: Assessed automatically; no separate application. Tuition only.

scholarships.name: International Futures Scholarship – 2027
scholarships.amount: 20% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the degree
scholarships.field: 10 listed courses (incl. Business, Psychology, Biomedical Science, Data Analytics, Engineering Practice)
scholarships.eligibility: Full fee-paying international students starting one of the 10 eligible degrees at a Murdoch Western Australian campus in 2027.
scholarships.notes: Awarded automatically at admission. Not for government-sponsored students or holders of another Murdoch scholarship.

scholarships.name: Massey University Alumni Doctoral Scholarship
scholarships.amount: $90,000 plus tuition fees (stipend over three years)
scholarships.field: All fields (aligned with university and supervisor priorities)
scholarships.eligibility: Massey University graduates (international or domestic) who hold a Massey doctoral offer or are in the first 12 months of a Massey doctorate.
scholarships.notes: Applications open 15 November 2026. Only for people who already hold a Massey degree. Recipients must be enrolled by 1 June of the award year.

scholarships.university: NOHA consortium (Universidad de Deusto and partner universities)
scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's in International Humanitarian Action (NOHA) Scholarship 2027–2029
scholarships.amount: €1,400 per month for 24 months (€33,600) towards travel, visa, installation and living costs
scholarships.eligibility: Graduates of any nationality applying full-time to the NOHA joint master's who have not held an Erasmus Mundus scholarship before.
scholarships.notes: Scholarship deadline 23:59 GMT. Taught across several European universities. The page lists participation costs separately and does not say the scholarship waives them, so not labelled fully funded.

scholarships.university: IHE Delft (coordinator), with IST Lisbon and TU Dresden
scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Scholarship – MSc Groundwater and Global Change (GroundwatCH) 2027
scholarships.amount: €1,400 per month living allowance for the two-year programme, plus participation costs (tuition, library and lab costs, insurance and mandatory fees)
scholarships.field: Groundwater, hydrology and climate change adaptation
scholarships.eligibility: Applicants of any nationality who have not had an Erasmus Mundus scholarship before.
scholarships.notes: Fully funded (tuition + living allowance). 3 Jan 2027 (23:59 Dutch time) is the deadline for Partner Country nationals; Programme Country (EU and associated) applicants have until 7 Feb 2027.

scholarships.university: Mundus Journalism consortium (Aarhus University, Danish School of Media and Journalism, University of Amsterdam, Charles University, City St George's and others)
scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Scholarship – Mundus Journalism MA 2027–2029
scholarships.amount: €1,400 per month for up to 24 months, full tuition waiver for both years, plus health and liability insurance
scholarships.eligibility: Applicants of all nationalities who meet admission requirements and have not held an Erasmus Mundus scholarship before.
scholarships.notes: Fully funded. Deadline 13:00 CET. One application for admission and scholarship; about 10–15 scholarships for top-ranked candidates.

scholarships.name: Danforth Scholars Program
scholarships.amount: Full tuition plus a $2,500 stipend, or partial tuition; renewable
scholarships.eligibility: First-year applicants to any WashU undergraduate school; international students are welcome to apply.
scholarships.notes: For priority consideration submit the Common App or Coalition App by 16 December 2026. Tuition only, not fully funded.

scholarships.name: Annika Rodriguez Scholars Program
scholarships.amount: Full tuition plus a $2,500 stipend, or partial tuition; renewable
scholarships.eligibility: First-year applicants to any WashU undergraduate school; international students are welcome to apply.
scholarships.notes: For priority consideration submit the Common App or Coalition App by 16 December 2026. Tuition only, not fully funded.

scholarships.name: Robertson Scholars Leadership Program
scholarships.amount: Eight semesters of full tuition, room and board and most mandatory fees, plus funding for up to three summer experiences
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors applying to Duke and/or UNC-Chapel Hill; international students can apply if they can obtain a US study visa.
scholarships.notes: Fully funded (tuition + room and board). Separate Robertson application, plus admission application to Duke and/or UNC. Time zone not stated.

scholarships.name: Ontario Graduate Scholarship (OGS)
scholarships.amount: C$10,000 or C$15,000 for up to one year (C$5,000 per term)
scholarships.eligibility: Full-time students in, or planning to enter, a Carleton graduate program in 2027–28; international students with a valid Ontario study permit can apply for the international places.
scholarships.notes: Closes 11:59pm EST; no late applications. External applicants send a PDF to their department's Graduate Administrator. Limited places for international students.

scholarships.name: Ontario Graduate Scholarship (OGS) 2027–28
scholarships.amount: Up to C$15,000 (C$5,000 per term)
scholarships.eligibility: Graduate students already registered at Waterloo (or on approved leave) by 1 Feb 2027; international students with a valid study permit may apply.
scholarships.notes: Application and references due 4:00pm ET; Intent to Apply form due 14 Jan 2027. Only 5 international OGS awards. Not open to students who are not yet enrolled.
